Underwriting Memo

What this catalog is really worth

Plain-English narrative built from the multi-method engine. Designed for finance-committee memos and partner intros.

The revenue-only model values this catalog at $361,193 (NTM × 5), but it under-anchors the catalog because the historical earning base of $57,362 over 12 months supports a comp range of $64,400–$90,200. Attention signals and a 5-factor strategic premium support pulling the band upward. After 0% in risk discounts and 20% in strategic premiums, the final internal range lands at $260,300–$417,100, with a suggested ask of $360,400 at 73% confidence.

What the Data Says

this catalog has 12 months of revenue history totaling $57,362, with a current monthly run rate of $6,020 and a projected NTM of $72,239. Deal readiness score: 75/100 (Partner Ready).

Revenue Model

Pure NTM-only model puts the base valuation at $361,193 (range $216,716–$469,600). This method is conservative — it can underestimate catalogs where the historical earning base is stronger than the recent run rate.

Historical Comp

Historical comp method applies a 1.6×–2.2× multiple to $57,362 of historical revenue, anchored by a quality factor of 81/100. Comp range: $64,400–$90,200.

Attention Signal

Attention-adjusted lens reads $221,800–$613,200 with a base of $383,900. Attention is converting into revenue — this supports a richer multiple.

Partner Lens

Streamfic is the highest-fit partner at 92/100. When the catalog has tracks that move in short-form, a structured creator campaign compounds reach into revenue.

Recommended Route

Strategy: Prepare for sync first. Sync revenue improves the multiple on financing later. Push a focused curation to Acrylic and prep stems with AudioShake before pricing for advance.

Why This May Be Worth More Than NTM Suggests

  • Attention is already converting into revenue. That cuts buyer underwriting risk and supports a richer multiple.
  • 2 tracks already anchor the catalog — reduces single-asset risk that buyers usually discount.
  • Multiple strategic premiums apply (social, sync, pipeline, diversification) — capped but compounding.

What Could Reduce the Offer

  • No material risks flagged — terms should hold under standard diligence.

Recommended Ask

RocketRolla suggested ask is $360,400 — anchored at the upper-mid of the final range ($260,300–$417,100) with 73% blended confidence.

Underwriting Detail · Risk Discounts & Strategic Premiums

Risk Discounts (0% total, capped −30%)

No risk discounts triggered.

Strategic Premiums (20% total, capped +20%)

  • Converting social momentum+7%

    Strong social signal that is already converting into revenue — partners pay for this.

  • Sync-ready catalog+5%

    Catalog has stems-ready / instrumental tracks suitable for sync placements.

  • Forward release pipeline+3%

    Confirmed upcoming releases or collaborations improve forward visibility.

  • Multiple revenue drivers+3%

    At least two tracks anchor the catalog — reduces single-track dependency.

  • Regional momentum (Latin)+2%

    Meaningful Latin-market footprint — adds a culturally relevant pathway.

Blended Underwriting Confidence

73%

Methods agreement: 20/100 · Pure NTM-only confidence: 72%

Model Assumptions

  • ·Five lenses are computed independently: revenue floor, historical comp, reliable annualized, momentum, track-level upside.
  • ·Historical comp uses 1.2×–2.4× historical revenue, scaled by a quality factor (rights, diversification, attention, growth).
  • ·Reliable annualized smooths L3 / L6 / L12 monthly revenue, weighted by consistency.
  • ·Attention values are log-scaled per metric and capped when ownership / metadata are weak.
  • ·Risk discounts cap at 30% total. Strategic premiums cap at 20% total.
  • ·The final base biases toward higher methods when premiums outweigh discounts, and toward lower methods when risks dominate.
  • ·Suggested ask sits at upper-mid of the final range (~8% above base).
